title: Reduction to 3-CNF satisfiability
statement: There is a polynomial-time computable function $f$ from Boolean strings to Boolean strings such that, for every Boolean string $x$, $x$ encodes a satisfiable directed acyclic Boolean circuit with at most two inputs per gate if and only if $f(x)$ encodes a satisfiable CNF formula in which every clause has at most three literals.
hypotheses_covered: The reduction function is polynomial-time computable
For every input string, membership in the circuit language is equivalent to membership of its image in the SAT3 language
